title: Frame, transform, and invert a signal
brief: Count and cut centered frames, build the STFT to match torch.stft, test the COLA condition, and invert the STFT by least squares to 1e-10.
hints: Build every frame at once: index = np.arange(frame_length)[None, :] + hop_length * np.arange(n_frames)[:, None], then x[index].
np.pad(x, n_fft // 2, mode='reflect') mirrors about the first and last sample without repeating them: [1, 2, 3] padded by 2 is [3, 2, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1].
np.fft.rfft(frames * window, axis=1) is frames by bins; transpose it with .T to get bins by frames.
For is_cola, window[r::hop].sum() is the total weight on every sample whose position is r modulo the hop.
In istft, loop over frames with signal[m * hop:m * hop + n_fft] += frame, and accumulate window ** 2 the same way. Trim n_fft // 2 from the front when centered.
